svg.desc: Source of public/og.png (the 1200x630 link-preview image); public/favicon.svg is the source of favicon-96.png and apple-touch-icon.png. Plain text on a solid background, so any SVG renderer gives the same image. On macOS, from packages/docs: sips -s format png scripts/assets/og.svg --out public/og.png sips -s format png -z 96 96 public/favicon.svg --out public/favicon-96.png sips -s format png -z 180 180 public/favicon.svg --out public/apple-touch-icon.png
